newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber up limit to new highs on strong cash.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber up limit to new highs on strong cash.

text.p: May CME lumber futures ran up the daily $10.00-per-thousand-board-feet limit for the second consecutive day and posted a new contract high and July followed for a limit gain as continued demand linked to strong cash lumber prices touched off buy stops, traders said.
May was up limit at $401.60 per tbf, its new contract high. July was limit up at $397.40 and other months were up $2.90 to $1.00 per tbf.
The discount futures held to cash lumber prices and the rising cash market elevated futures into buy stops. Cash sources reported sales Wednesday above $400 per tbf, they said.
